ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white) pixels to 60% low-intensity (dark) pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Dominant low-intensity black field with irregular high-intensity white mottling clustered in the distal quadrant. Right lobe: Contiguous high-intensity white field covering approximately 70% of the lobe area, with low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated along the leading edge and proximal base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped vertex with an approximate 50-degree internal angle and deep vertical penetration relative to the fluke horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, medium-amplitude serrations (peaks/valleys) along the continuous trailing edge boundary; right lobe shows more uniform serration than the irregular left lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips, transitioning to convex leading edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density circular clusters of high-contrast, textured pixels (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer distal tips of both lobes and along the right leading edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the high-intensity white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation on the distal tips causing structural perimeter irregularities; possible minor tissue loss on the left lobe trailing edge near the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Isolated low-intensity pigment 'island' located within the upper-medial region of the right lobe white field.
